part1_analytic: No CW => max out-degree <= M-2. Unique max => others <= M-3 => total <= (M-2)+(M-1)(M-3) = M^2-3M+1, but total = M(M-1)/2; inequality M^2-3M+1 >= M(M-1)/2 <=> M^2-5M+2 >= 0 <=> M >= 4.56. Hence for M<=4 every no-CW tournament has a top tie of size >= 2 (M=3: 3-cycle, all scores 1; M=4: score sequences (2,2,1,1) or (2,2,2,0)).
